name: art-agent
author: Art Agent
description: Safe-by-default local Windows MCP development agent for ChatGPT and Codex.

scripts.desktop:package: npm run prepare:windows-icon && npm run build && electron-forge package --platform=win32 --arch=x64
scripts.desktop:make: npm run prepare:windows-icon && npm run build && electron-forge make --platform=win32 --arch=x64
scripts.test: node --import tsx --test test/security.test.ts test/files.test.ts test/git.test.ts test/process.test.ts test/changes.test.ts test/tasks.test.ts test/codex.test.ts test/settings.test.ts test/desktop.test.ts test/version.test.ts test/installer.test.ts
